title: R1250RT Luxury Tourer (Sport Black)
description: The BMW Motorrad R1250RT Luxury Tourer (Sport Black) is engineered for blistering apex speeds and track dominance, positioned in the Luxury Grand Tourer segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 1250cc engine generating 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 228 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck riding stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
